name: Honda VFR1200F
engine: 1237 cc liquid-cooled V4, fuel injected, shaft drive, manual or DCT
intro: Honda's big shaft-drive V4. 2010 and 2012-2013 bikes had a driveshaft recall and a fuel pump recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2010 and 2012-2013 VFR1200F and FD bikes are in recall 15V821 (driveshaft U-joint) and recall 24V864 (fuel pump).
A-002.reason: A broken U-joint can lock the rear wheel. Both fixes are free.

recalls.what: Driveshaft U-joint bearings can wear early and break, which can lock the rear wheel.
Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the fuel pump free.
